component.name: Wali
component.summary: Lightweight unofficial WhatsApp Web desktop client for Linux

description.p: Wali is an unofficial Linux desktop client that loads WhatsApp Web in a native window using the system WebKitGTK engine.

It keeps a persistent session, provides a system tray, close-to-tray, desktop notifications, Downloads-folder file saving, and a local Settings window. WhatsApp Web itself is unchanged: Wali does not inject JavaScript or CSS into the page and does not implement a custom WhatsApp protocol.
Wali is not affiliated with Meta or WhatsApp.
Install a Wayland-matching desktop entry so KWin shows the Wali icon.
